typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchiveFileFolder as string (),
	FilePattern as string (),
	ParentPackageExecutionID as integer (),
	startTime as string ()
}

source(output(
		BudgetType as string,
		EmployeeID as string,
		Division as string,
		Jan as string,
		Feb as string,
		Mar as string,
		Apr as string,
		May as string,
		Jun as string,
		Jul as string,
		Aug as string,
		Sep as string,
		Oct as string,
		Nov as string,
		Dec as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ReadFromSourceFile
ReadFromSourceFile derive(BudgetType = BudgetType) ~> PlaceHolderRowsReadNoError
ReadFromSourceFile derive() ~> ReadFromSourceFileErrorReformat
PlaceHolderRowsReadNoError unpivot(output(
		BudgetMonth as string,
		BudgetAmount as string
	),
	ungroupBy(BudgetType,
		Division,
		EmployeeID
	),
	lateral: false,
	ignoreNullPivots: false) ~> Unpivot
ReadFromSourceFileErrorReformat derive() ~> ReadFromSourceFile0
Unpivot derive(FileName = toString((replace($FileLocation, toString($FileDropFolder + '\\UserTbl\\'), toString('')))),
		ETLCreateDate = $startTime,
		ETLExecutionID = $PackageExecutionID,
		BudgetAmount = (iif(BudgetAmount == '', '0', BudgetAmount))) ~> DeriveAuditandOtherColumns
ReadFromSourceFile0 sink(input(
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn()) ~> ReadFromSourceFileERROROUTPUTFILE
DeriveAuditandOtherColumns sink(input(
		ETLCreateDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		FileName as string,
		ETLExecutionID as long,
		BudgetMonth as string,
		Division as string,
		EmployeeID as string,
		BudgetType as string,
		BudgetAmount as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		ETLCreateDate,
		FileName,
		ETLExecutionID,
		BudgetMonth,
		Division,
		EmployeeID,
		BudgetType,
		BudgetAmount)) ~> InserttoTarget
